topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The rain was coming down hard, just like the news. I stood there, cigarette almost forgotten between my fingers, staring at the neon sign that flickered for one last time. They said the place was closing, and something in me knew this was more than just a shuttered door. It was a piece of the street, a bit of the city that had seen me through the rough patches, now slipping away. Folks around here, they talk, they gossip, but when the lights go out on a place like Johnny's, you can hear the echoes of the past fading. You start to wonder what else might disappear before you even notice. The night grew colder, and I couldn't help but think, what next?
